args.body: If the NASA capture commits, use it as a pointer to original rules within the existing allowance of two rule sets. Prioritize a live fixed prize with a discrete offline data or documentation deliverable. Build and execute a small sample only once the original rules establish the acceptance criterion, intended entrant eligibility, whether disclosed AI work is permitted, and the submission and payout terms. Keep any response as an operator draft. If the official material cannot establish a fit, preserve the exact gap and what would reopen the route, then close under a valid lease after readback with a lesson.

Close the private preparation mission and keep the referral available if those conditions are met. Commercial feedback contains no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded, with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
